messages.en: What are you doing~

messages.ko: 무빙 옵적 하연이가 즉석에서 아이디어 낸거야?
messages.en: Did you come up with the Moving Objekt idea on the spot?
Of course. ㅋ
Genius, right?
Originally it was supposed to be a little less intense and just cute.
But it turned into an intense dumpling.
Isn't it the cutest Objekt?
I'm thinking of making the next Objekt completely cool.
What do you think?
But I'm still way too cute!!!!!
Today I'm going for a more mature vibe.
Look forward to it.

messages.ko: 오늘 집중해서 봐야하는 얼굴 포인트 알려줘
messages.en: Tell me which part of your face I should focus on the most today.
Hmm.
Everything...?
Or...
The honey-dripping look in my eyes whenever I look at **Y/n**...?
Are you planning on being noisy again today?
I told you, today I'm mature.
Right now...
I'm going to eat Yubin-unnie's kalguksu.
So good.
Wow.
It's so delicious.
Why does this kimchi taste like seasoned soy-marinated crab?
Wow, I really ate well.

messages.ko: 아까 유빈언니가 막 먹다가 나를 쳐다보는거야
messages.en: Earlier, while we were eating, Yubin-unnie suddenly looked at me.
She said the kimchi splashed.

messages.ko: 응? 근데 왜 날 쳐다봐 했는데
messages.en: I was like, 'Huh? Then why are you looking at me?'
Turns out it had splashed toward me!!!!!
But I had a blanket over me.
Miraculously, it didn't get on my clothes.
Lucky girl.
Lucky Luna, you know~~~
I'm with the Zenith members right now.
It's so chaotic.
This isn't easy.
I should...
Go straighten them out a little.
I'll get everyone in line and come back.
(38 minutes later)
I ended up being the one who got put in line.
I didn't get to say goodbye properly.
Now I'm really going to go practice hard.
See you a little later. 🤭😍
Haranghae.
